tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Remaining all other terms and conditions are as per the attached Tender Document.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder should furnish all the Technical Documents as mentioned in the Tender Document.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Certificate of Registration under Professional Tax issued by Commercial Tax Department, Government of Karnataka
Certified Audited balance sheet with profit and loss account income and expenditure for the last three years .
Challan of professional tax remittance for the amount collected last one years
Challan of service tax remittance for the amount collected during last one year,

Details of documents pertaining to Three years of experience in providing Manpower Services to Government of Karnataka /Government of India/Semi Government Undertakings/Government Institutions like universities etc
Goods and Service Tax Registration certificate.
Previous one year statements of half yearly & yearly returns submitted to Employee State Insurance ESI authorities
Proof for filing IT returns for last three years i.e. 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26
Provident Fund Registration Certificate issued by the Regional Provident Fund Commissioner.
Quarterly e-TDs returns filed and its assessment copies for last 4 quarters are to be uploaded.
Registration certificate for registering under pertinent act and competent Government authority
Registration Certificate under Employees State Insurance Act - ESI ACT
Total Turnover of at least Rs. 50.00 lakh cumulative in any one year during last three years. i.e. 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26
Valid Registration Certificate with the labour department.
